title: Tamper-evident admin event ledger with region-bound proofs
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Build an append-only, tamper-evident event ledger for admin actions (RBAC changes, config updates, privileged access) that attaches cryptographic proofs and region residency metadata. The ledger must be compatible with existing retention policies and exportable to the sealed evidence pipeline for legal hold.

Background: Current admin activity is captured in multiple places (console audits, cloud audit logs, auth provider traces). We need a single canonical record for compliance artifacts that provides: 1) immutable ordering, 2) cryptographic integrity proofs (Merkle timestamps), 3) residency annotations per event, and 4) lightweight on-disk WORM-compatible bundles for escrow/export.

Success criteria / acceptance: 
- Canonical ledger created and populated for all admin route handlers (console, API, private control plane) for a subset of events (config change, role grant/revoke, service-account impersonation).
- Each ledger entry includes sha256 of payload, ISO8601 timestamp, region tag, actor id, and Merkle leaf proof anchored to a signing service.
- Export tooling produces sealed evidence bundles that are write-once readable (WORM semantics) and verifiable with public proof material.
- Integration tests that simulate a tamper attempt and validate detection via proof mismatch.
- Documentation and runbook for legal export and on-call steps for suspected tamper.

Constraints / non-goals: 
- This ticket does not include full cross-region replication optimization for high-throughput tenants (follow-up). 
- Not replacing cloud provider audit logs; ledger complements them as canonical enterprise artifact.
comments: 2026-02-22 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting completed. Alignment with Legal and Trust on required fields and proof retention. Legal requested region-level residency markers and 7-year retention for enterprise plans.

2026-02-28 - Marco Li: Spike implemented for Merkle tree service. PoC stores leaves in Dynamo-like KV; signing service issues timestamped signatures. Latency added ~6ms per admin write in PoC. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1892
2026-03-05 - Security review (initial): Jake Nguyen: Recommended HSM-backed signing for production; flagged key rotation and archival key custodianship as follow-ups.

2026-03-09 - PR feedback from infra: switched to async batching of proof anchors to avoid tail latency for console flows; added backpressure path that falls back to a transient 'pending-proofs' queue when signer is throttled.

2026-03-11 - QA: Added integration test that mutates stored ledger bytes and verifies verification api returns mismatch; test passes locally, flaky in CI due to eventual consistency; investigating flaky assertion timing.

2026-03-13 - Marco Li: Rolling deployment to staging for canary accounts. Observability dashboard added: http://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/admin-audit-overview. Next: finalize export format and create WORM packaging job for sealed storage.
